title: A Storm in the City
text:
Last summer, a big storm came to our city. The wind was very strong, and heavy rain fell for many hours. Some streets were full of water, so cars could not drive through them. Many people stayed at home and waited for the storm to finish.

After the storm, the city workers came to help. They cleaned the streets and fixed the broken trees. Some families lost their roofs, so neighbours brought food and blankets to them. People learned that it is important to help each other in a difficult time.

questions.text: What fell for many hours during the storm?
What did the city workers do after the storm?
options: They cleaned the streets and fixed the broken trees.
They closed the schools for a year.
They moved the families to another city.
They built a new bridge over the river.

questions.text: Why could cars not drive through some streets?
options: The streets were full of water.

questions.text: What can we infer about the neighbours?
options: They helped families who needed support.
They left the city during the storm.
They did not like their neighbours.

the top coverings of buildings or houses
large warm covers used on a bed

paragraph_translations: Latem nasze miasto nawiedziła duża burza. Wiatr był bardzo silny, a przez wiele godzin padał gęsty deszcz. Niektóre ulice były pełne wody, więc samochody nie mogły nimi przejechać. Wielu ludzi zostało w domu i czekało, aż burza się skończy.

Po burzy na pomoc przyszli pracownicy miejscy. Posprzątali ulice i naprawili połamane drzewa. Niektóre rodziny straciły dachy, więc sąsiedzi przynieśli im jedzenie i koce. Ludzie przekonali się, że w trudnych chwilach ważne jest wzajemne wsparcie.
